Your selected direction

  • Navigation drawer for the two main destinations.
  • Comfortable rows with photos and separate rank badges.
  • Singles chart on its own screen; doubles history stays inline.
  • Green palette, system light/dark appearance, and neutral photo fallbacks.

Public player identities and portraits are embedded from tabletennis.az. Match results, charts, movement, and update times are illustrative. This file works offline; the Android app has not changed yet.
